html: A migraine is a headache that can cause throbbing pain, usually on one side of the head, often with nausea and sensitivity to light and sound. Attacks can last hours to days.

• Stress
  • Changes in sleep
  • Skipped meals
  • Hormonal changes
  • Certain foods or drinks

• Keep a headache diary to spot triggers
  • Rest in a quiet, dark room during an attack
  • Talk with your care team about treatment and prevention options
Get emergency care for a sudden, severe "worst ever" headache, or a headache with fever, stiff neck, confusion, weakness, or trouble speaking.
